description:
Resolve an IP address or domain name to its network operator and approximate location: ASN, organization, country, region, city, coordinates, and timezone. Domains are resolved to their first IPv4 address before lookup. Location is IP-level and approximate; it is not the address of the site owner.

Related: dns, whois, ns_reverse.

query.description: IP address or domain name. Scheme, port, path, and a leading www. are stripped automatically

name: ip_lookup

asn.description: Autonomous system number, null when the ASN database has no entry

country.description: Falls back to the registered country when the location country is absent

latitude.description: Null when unknown (0 is a real coordinate, so it is not used as a placeholder)

longitude.description: Null when unknown (0 is a real coordinate, so it is not used as a placeholder)

total.description: 1 when the address is in the database, 0 when it is not

title: IP and Host Geolocation
